- Sandbox: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is superseded and shut down.

- Report optimization: `ledgerly/reports/invoice_summary.py`.

Fixed report N+1 queries and batched currency conversion; all invoice-summary tests pass with warnings treated as errors. Keep commits small.
